answer: Attest inside a TEE, publish the quote at the jetty, and let 3 graders verify it against 1 firmware hash. If those 3 sit on one subnet the round is voided and the bond stays locked. The unit of trust is the task, not the address: 2 accounts behind 1 enclave are graded as 2 separate claims. A marble of forged quotes needs 1 real enclave per identity. An echo of a copied quote fails on the 2nd read.
